info.name: Loan Lifecycle API
info.description:
**Lifecycle** matches **Swagger UI**, **`javascript/mock-server/openapi.json`**, and **`DOCUMENTATION.md`** §**5** (happy path §**5.0**, production phase map §**5.4**). **OpenAPI 0.7+** adds **GET /v1/health**, **GET /v1/reference/loan-products**, response headers **`X-Correlation-Id`** / **`X-Request-Id`**, optional **`Idempotency-Key`** on authenticated **POST**.

**Order:** **Login** → **KYC** → Create → Submit → **Ops accept** → **Disclosures acknowledge** → Credit → **Start underwriting** → **Underwriting decision** → (optional **stipulations**) → **Funding authorize** → **Fund** (book) → **Disburse** → Get loan → Schedule → Payment(s) → Payoff → optional **Logout**.

**Tracing:** Collection **Pre-request** sets **`X-Correlation-Id`** (or **`correlation_id_override`** from the environment). **Tests** copy response **`X-Correlation-Id`** / **`X-Request-Id`** into **`last_correlation_id`** / **`last_request_id`**. **Idempotency:** set environment **`idempotency_key`** (any unique string); it is sent on **POST** requests as **`Idempotency-Key`** (clear it when you do not need deduplication).

**Production alignment:** Vocabulary follows common **LOS / origination + servicing** narratives; this is a **teaching sandbox**, not a full bank stack — see **`DOCUMENTATION.md`** §**5.4** for what real institutions add.

**Import-ready flow:** folder **Flow — Happy path (import & run in order)** (this guide §**7**).

**Stipulation tests:** **Tests — stipulations (single & multiple)** — Runner subfolders **A** (1 stip) and **B** (3 stips).

**Setup:** import **`postman/collection/Loan_Lifecycle_API.postman_collection.json`** and **`postman/environments/Local_Mock.postman_environment.json`** — select **Loan Lifecycle — Local mock**.

**OpenAPI / Swagger:** environment **`openapi_url`** and **`swagger_url`**, or import **`javascript/mock-server/openapi.json`** in Postman.

**Auth:** **`access_token`** from **Login**; collection Bearer except **Login** and **System & reference**. Password **`demo`** or **`demo123`**. **KYC** is required before **Create application** (**403** if skipped).

**URLs:** Use **`api_root`** for all **`/v1/...`** calls (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1`). Use **`base_url`** for **`/openapi.json`** and **`/docs`** only — do **not** put **`/v1`** in **`base_url`** or you will get **`/v1/v1/...`** and stray **401**s. **`npm run test:integration`** uses port **9876** — set **`base_url`**, **`api_root`**, **`openapi_url`**, and **`swagger_url`** accordingly.

item.name: System & reference (no auth)
item.description: **Unauthenticated** probes aligned with **`openapi.json` 0.7+**. Run before **Login** to confirm the mock is up and read product catalogue **term_months** LOV.

request.description: **GET /v1/health** — liveness, **environment**, **api_revision**. No Bearer.
**GET /v1/reference/loan-products** — approved **term_months** and limits. No Bearer.

item.name: Flow — Happy path (import & run in order)
item.description: Same journey as **Swagger** operation order and **`DOCUMENTATION.md`** §**5.0**. Run **Collection Runner** on **this folder only** (top to bottom). Environment: **Loan Lifecycle — Local mock**. **Login** → **KYC** → numbered steps **1 … 14**; **15. Logout** is optional. Steps **1** and **7** save **application_id** and **loan_id** via Tests. If step **7** is **CONDITIONAL**, it also sets **`stipulation_ids_json`** and **`stipulation_id`** — run **Fulfill all stipulations** in folder **Conditional — fulfill stipulations** once, then **9. Fund** (after **8. Funding — authorize**).

request.description: Public — no Bearer header. Password must be **demo** or **demo123**. Saves **access_token** for the collection.
Requires **Login** first. Mandatory before **Create loan application** (otherwise **403**).
Creates a DRAFT application. **`term_months`** must be one of **6, 12, 18, 24, 32, 36** (product catalogue). Saves `application_id`.
Moves application to SUBMITTED for credit / ops.
LOS-style: **SUBMITTED** → **IN_PROCESSING** (ops / processing queue).
Initial disclosure package acknowledged (sandbox gate before **credit-check**).
Sandbox credit step. Use `force_outcome`: PASS or FAIL, or `simulated_credit_score` (below 620 declines without force).
**CREDIT_COMPLETED** → **IN_UNDERWRITING** (underwriting queue) before **decision**.

Straight **APPROVE** → **PENDING_FUNDING** (no stips). For **CONDITIONAL**, replace body with `outcome` + `stipulations[]` — Tests save **`loan_id`**, **`stipulation_ids_json`** (all UUIDs), and the first open **`stipulation_id`**. Clear all stips in **one** call: **POST …/stipulations/fulfill-all** (folder **Conditional — fulfill stipulations**). Or fulfill one-by-one with **`{{stipulation_id}}`**. Empty **`stipulation_id`** yields `.../stipulations//fulfill` → **404**.
**PENDING_FUNDING** → **CLEARED_FOR_BOOKING** — production-style **clear-to-fund** before **GL** booking.
Books the loan: **CLEARED_FOR_BOOKING** → **FUNDED** (`funded_at`). Requires **8. Funding — authorize** first.
Sends proceeds to the borrower: **FUNDED** → **ACTIVE** (`disbursed_at`). Requires **9. Fund** first.
After **Disburse**, expect **`status`: ACTIVE** and **`balance_cents`** for repayments.
Illustrative amortization-style schedule from the mock (demo only).

Loan must be **ACTIVE** (run **10. Disburse** first). **`method`**: **ACH** (installments / NACHA-style) or **WIRE** (domestic wire / payoff-style). Set `payment_amount_cents`; use **Get loan** → `balance_cents` for a full payoff.
Closes the loan on the mock (**CLOSED**). Run after the loan is paid down or for demo teardown.
Invalidates **access_token** — you must **Login** again for further protected calls. Clears **access_token** in the active environment (if any) and collection.

item.name: Tests — stipulations (single & multiple)
item.description: Automated checks for **CONDITIONAL** underwriting. Run **Tests — A** *or* **Tests — B** in **Collection Runner** (not together). Requires mock: **`npm run start:mock`**. Restart the mock between A and B if the same server session causes conflicts (fresh DB each process — in-memory reset on restart only if you restart).

item.name: Tests — A: Single stipulation (CONDITIONAL)
item.description: **Collection Runner:** select **only this folder**. Fresh **`application_id`** each run. Chain ends at **FUNDED** (no disburse). Assertions: one stip after underwriting, **fulfill-all** returns one id, fund succeeds.

item.description: After **step 7** (underwriting) with **CONDITIONAL**, Tests set **`stipulation_ids_json`** and **`stipulation_id`**. **Preferred:** run **Fulfill all stipulations** once. **Alternative:** per-stip fulfills. Then **8. Funding — authorize** and **9. Fund**. With **straight APPROVE**, skip this folder.

item.name: Edge cases (manual QA)
item.description:
Run these **after** you understand the happy path. Expect **4xx** responses — that is correct for invalid actions.

**Auth:** run **Login** (and **KYC** if the scenario touches loan create) before edge requests that need a token — or duplicate requests with **Login** + **KYC** in the same folder.

**Setup tips:** EC3 needs **`loan_id`** from a full path through **10. Disburse** (loan **ACTIVE**). EC5: through **9. Fund**, skip **10. Disburse** (loan **FUNDED**). EC6: through **7** (underwriting) only — no **funding/authorize** or **fund** (loan **PENDING_FUNDING**). Restart the mock between setups if needed.

request.description: Requires **`loan_id`** from the full happy path **1 → 6** (including **Disburse**) so the loan is **ACTIVE**. Body overpays intentionally.

item.name: EC5. Pay before disburse — loan FUNDED only (expect 409)

request.description: **Setup:** Through **9. Fund**, **do not** run **10. Disburse**. Loan is **FUNDED**; payments require **ACTIVE** — mock returns **409**.
**Setup:** Through **7. Underwriting decision** only (**no** **8. Funding — authorize** / **9. Fund**). Loan is **PENDING_FUNDING**; **disburse** requires **FUNDED** — mock returns **409**.
